_comment: Dual-Pool Stratum Proxy config. Copy to config.json and edit. ratio_a is Pool A's share (0-100). Each pool may add optional "startdiff" and "mindiff" numbers to force a difficulty floor for pools that require one (e.g. public-pool.io wants ~100000); omit them to use the pool's own difficulty (default 42/1). See docs/CONFIGURATION.md.
